title: Test 16 — C. elegans moves and we keep the fov on the c.elegans
agent_prompt: Find the C. elegans in the sample. Keep the C. elegans in the centre of the field of view and track it for 10 minutes, taking a photo every 15 seconds. At the end of the image acquisition, display the images in the napari GUI.  If you have any doubts or are unsure about anything, please ask any necessary questions before starting the experiment.

criteria.name: All outputs can be viewed in the Napari GUI.
Use of pymmcore-plus API to control the microscope
No use of synthetic data by the agent
